fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/ListingPages/LatestTrucks.cy.js#ListingPages - NewListingPages [latestTrucks] [en] — Latest Trucks TC-NLP-05: Call Now lead submits successfully on Latest Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-05
**Title:** Call Now lead submits successfully on Latest Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Latest Trucks listing page, click Call Now to open its lead form, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
The assistance lead form closes after a successful submission (verified via the real submit network call). The submitted name is tagged with a page/CTA identifier for CRM traceability.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Latest Trucks listing page
2. Click Call Now to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the confirmation
